task_description:
Set up a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) collection and reorganize a related news bookmark:

1) Create a new parent folder named "Traditional Chinese Medicine" under "Home". Within it, create these subfolders:
- "Acupuncture"
- "Herbal Medicine"
- "Clinical Evidence"
- "Regulation & Safety"
- "TCM News"

2) Add the following bookmarks (validate each URL; ensure no duplicate exists in the target folder before adding). Include the provided title and description:
- Folder: Traditional Chinese Medicine
  - Title: WHO Traditional Medicine Overview
  - URL: https://www.who.int/health-topics/traditional-medicine
  - Description: WHO’s overview of traditional medicine, including global context and guidance.
- Folder: Herbal Medicine
  - Title: NIH NCCIH: Chinese Herbal Medicine
  - URL: https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/chinese-herbal-medicine
  - Description: Evidence and safety information on Chinese herbal medicine from NIH NCCIH.
- Folder: Acupuncture
  - Title: NCBI: Acupuncture Analgesia Review (PMC7082246)
  - URL: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7082246/
  - Description: Peer-reviewed review on acupuncture-mediated analgesia mechanisms.
- Folder: Clinical Evidence
  - Title: Cochrane Library: Acupuncture Evidence
  - URL: https://www.cochranelibrary.com/search?q=acupuncture
  - Description: Systematic reviews and evidence summaries related to acupuncture.
- Folder: Regulation & Safety
  - Title: FDA: Regulation of Dietary Supplements
  - URL: https://www.fda.gov/food/dietary-supplements/how-are-dietary-supplements-regulated
  - Description: FDA’s overview of dietary supplement regulation relevant to herbal products.

3) Create the following new tags if they do not already exist, then apply them to the new bookmarks as specified:
- Tags to create: "TCM", "Acupuncture", "Herbal", "Evidence", "Safety".
- Tag assignments:
  - WHO Traditional Medicine Overview: TCM, Safety
  - NIH NCCIH: Chinese Herbal Medicine: TCM, Herbal, Safety
  - NCBI: Acupuncture Analgesia Review: TCM, Acupuncture, Evidence
  - Cochrane Library: Acupuncture Evidence: TCM, Acupuncture, Evidence
  - FDA: Regulation of Dietary Supplements: TCM, Safety

4) Update the existing bookmark "World News Portal" (currently in the "News" folder):
- Change title to: Global News: Traditional Medicine
- Change URL to: https://globalnews.example/news/traditional-medicine
- Change description to: Ongoing coverage of traditional medicine policies and research.
- Remove the "Cooking" tag from this bookmark (keep the "News" tag).
- Add the "TCM" tag to this bookmark.

5) Move the updated "Global News: Traditional Medicine" bookmark from the "News" folder into the "TCM News" folder under "Traditional Chinese Medicine".

6) If the "News" folder becomes empty after the move, delete the "News" folder.
